title: Source map scan index
summary: This iteration makes the fixed source map easier to scan before reading every logical source. It adds a compact source-map index with per-section counts for included, need-action, updated-not-selected, and low-signal rows, then renders each fixed source section as a stable `source-map-group-*` markdown panel that the index can link to without exposing internal audit data.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source map scan index|source-first IA dashboard|source-first IA status focus" tests/unit.test.js
Playwright desktop/mobile visual check for docs/reports/2026/06/2026-06-29.html

lessons.lesson: Production daily markdown strips raw HTML before rendering.
lessons.evidence: The first E2E pass failed because raw `<span>` and `<a id>` markers were removed from the pre-rendered HTML. The final implementation uses markdown links to renderer-native section ids instead.
lessons.recommended_action: For public daily anchors, prefer stable `richId` section ids over raw HTML embedded inside markdown content.

lessons.lesson: A full source graph needs a scan layer before detailed rows.
lessons.evidence: The source-map section now lists every fixed source group with deterministic counts and links to the matching detailed `source-map-group-*` section.
lessons.recommended_action: When expanding the logical source list, keep new sections in the display contract and rely on the scan index to preserve reader orientation.

followups.action: After the fixed importance order is manually tuned, replay a larger source_effectiveness fixture to check the index remains compact with the expanded logical source graph.
